prompt.project_info: Create a raw photorealistic nighttime resort snapshot beside a blue-lit pool, preserving the pink swimwear, frontal flash and deep blue background.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with light natural skin, shoulder-length brown hair and realistic natural skin texture. She wears a light-pink two-piece swimsuit with thin straps and a tied side detail. She stands with a neutral direct gaze and relaxed posture.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 medium portrait framed from the hips upward at eye level. Keep the torso slightly angled, left hand holding the side tie near the hip and right arm resting straight down. Include dark wooden railing, vivid blue illuminated pool, silhouetted palm trees and pitched-roof resort buildings.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh frontal smartphone flash creates high-contrast highlights and shadows on the subject, while blue pool lights and dim resort lighting illuminate the background. Preserve slight dark-area noise and candid nighttime atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 vertical raw smartphone flash photography, sharp foreground focus, slight background blur, natural skin imperfections and specular highlights, realistic pool reflections and restrained color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a raw photorealistic nighttime resort snapshot of one original approved adult woman with light natural skin, shoulder-length brown hair and realistic natural skin texture. She wears a light-pink two-piece swimsuit with thin straps and a tied side detail. Use a 3:4 medium portrait framed from the hips upward at eye level; keep her torso slightly angled, left hand holding the side tie near the hip and right arm resting straight down, with a neutral direct gaze. Include a dark wooden railing, vivid blue illuminated pool, silhouetted palm trees and pitched-roof resort buildings. Use harsh frontal smartphone flash with high-contrast highlights, blue pool light, dim resort ambience, slight background blur, natural skin imperfections, realistic reflections and subtle dark-area noise.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, body-part emphasis, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, wardrobe malfunction, unreadable text or logos
